explication: ATLAS is a local coding agent: a developer chats through the terminal UI, the proxy routes and orchestrates work, and the V3 pipeline generates, verifies, scores, and repairs code before returning it. Geometric Lens supplies candidate scoring and pattern-cache context; local inference and sandbox execution provide model and verification services. The README documents additional Lens/ASA training and operational capabilities, but their full wiring is not shown in the sampled source, so uncertain links are omitted.
